author: Inside Edition
description: These individuals posed as something they weren't in order to allegedly carry out crimes. In 2025, there were several cases of people posing as construction workers to break into people's houses. In 2022, a man posed as someone selling candy to assist with a home invasion in California. In 2025, police responded to a disturbance call and found another cop, or someone pretending to be one, already there. Inside Edition Digital' Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Police Say These Imposters Used Disguises to Commit Crimes

author: Inside Edition
description: A brother and sister made a bet at a family wedding. The bet was that at the wedding of whichever sibling got married first, the other sibling had to do a solo dance for over a minute and a half. Fast-forward 15 years, Grace Brockman married the love of her life, Colin Nation. Grace's brother Grant Brockman, now 21, held up his end of the deal, performing a 90-second dance at his sister's wedding in South Carolina.
title: Brother Follows Through On Bet Made With Sister 15 Years Later
